source='''def transform(grid):
    frame = grid[0][0]
    left_width = next((j for j, value in enumerate(grid[0]) if value == 0), len(grid[0]))
    dividers = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(value == frame for value in row[:left_width])]
    output = [row[:left_width] for row in grid]
    right_columns = list(range(left_width + 1, len(grid[0]) - 1))

    objects = {}
    for top, bottom in zip(dividers, dividers[1:]):
        colors = {grid[i][j] for i in range(top + 1, bottom) for j in right_columns if grid[i][j] != 0}
        for color in colors:
            shape = tuple(tuple(int(grid[i][j] == color) for j in right_columns) for i in range(top + 1, bottom))
            objects[shape] = color

    for top, bottom in zip(dividers, dividers[1:]):
        holes = tuple(tuple(int(grid[i][j] == 0) for j in range(1, left_width - 1)) for i in range(top + 1, bottom))
        color = objects[holes]
        for i in range(top + 1, bottom):
            for j in range(1, left_width - 1):
                if output[i][j] == 0:
                    output[i][j] = color
    return output
'''
